executive_summary: Implementation-plan module of the provincial Groningen scheme against grid congestion on business parks (Subsidieregeling Oplossen netcongestiebelemmeringen op bedrijventerreinen, Nationaal Programma Groningen), run by SNN. It funds an implementation plan, drawn up by an independent expert for a collaboration of at least two companies on a business park, that turns the results of a prior feasibility study (no older than two years) into collective solutions with a plan of approach, cost estimate and business case. Only collaborations of companies active in the province of Groningen may apply. The subsidy is 75% of eligible costs, up to EUR 15,000, under de minimis rules, from a sub-budget of EUR 550,000 allocated first come, first served. Applications are open from 25 March 2025 to 1 July 2028; the plan must be completed within 12 months.
status_rationale: The module funds an independent implementation plan with collective solutions, a plan of approach, cost estimate and business case for a collaboration of companies on a business park facing grid congestion (Verordening Subsidieregeling Oplossen netcongestie bedrijventerreinen (NPG), art. 5 lid 2 and 7; Toelichting, art. 5 lid 2). It touches TenneT's field directly through collective congestion solutions such as shared connections, storage and flexible use, sharing aims with the Lion Storage contract, the Energy boards and Grids & Benefits, but at business-park level behind the meter. Only collaborations of at least two companies with a business park in the province may apply (art. 1n and 3 lid 4), and the scheme gives no role to a grid operator, so TenneT cannot take part. It fits C3.3 because the plans prepare flexibility and demand-side solutions that relieve congestion.
